content.heading: Less managing. More living.
body: This afternoon, you have an idea. You find a quiet moment, open your laptop, and think you’ll finally get to it today.
Then there’s a reply to write. A meeting to rearrange. A PDF document somewhere in that thread. Before you know it, the afternoon is slipping away and the idea is still sitting where you left it.

items.title: We know that day. We’ve lived it too.
items.body: It’s why we’re building Merlin, an AI assistant for your Mac. Something you can turn to in the middle of all this and say, “Can you give me a hand?”

items.title: And there it is. A little room.
items.body: After the call, there’s a trip to sort out. Merlin looks through flights in your browser and helps with the booking, stopping for your approval before you commit. One more thing off your mind.

items.title: Your time. Yours to spend.
items.body: Before you finish, you set up a routine for your next morning briefing. The familiar work has a place to go. It doesn’t all have to live in your head when you step away.
